desc: Howard, in all red clothes, points his finger at Raj, Leonard, and Sheldon while eating Chinese food and conversing.
Raj, in a purple sweater, points his finger at Leonard and laughs, while Sheldon looks surprised and confused, while eating Chinese food.
Howard, in all red clothes, puts down his plate and pulls his phone out of his pocket.
Sheldon, in a blue shirt, while eating takeout with chopsticks, raises one shoulder.
Howard, in all red clothes, walks over to the couch with the bottle in his hands and sits next to Sheldon.
Howard sits down on the couch, wearing all red, flipping his hand and touching his ear nervously.
Howard, wearing all red, sobs, holds his hand to his face and turns away from the other guys.
Howard, wearing all red, lies back on the couch and massages his inner elbow.
Howard, wearing all red, sits up straight from lying back on the couch and covers his mouth with his hand.
Leonard is placing napkins on the couch between Sheldon and Howard, who is wearing all red.
Sheldon walks into the apartment building with a bag of take-out food and sees Penny, in an orange shirt taking her mail from the mailbox.
Sheldon walks up to the door and searches through his pockets for the apartment keys, surprised and scared.
Sheldon, in a white and beige jacket, pulls the door handle and tries to enter, screaming.
Leonard plucks his eyebrows and Raj combs his hair in the bathroom, next to each other.
Raj picks up a large strip of gold condoms while standing in the bathroom next to Leonard.
Howard, in a blue turtleneck, is typing on his laptop, sitting at a desk in a hotel room, when Raj and Leonard walk in.
Sheldon, in a white and beige jacket, enters the messy apartment while holding a plastic bag right after Penny, in an orange shirt.
Penny, in an orange shirt, reaches under the kitchen counter and gets an orange box, searching for something.
Penny, in an orange shirt, goes into the kitchen and picks the phone up off the counter.
Sheldon, in a white and beige jacket, yells and grabs his plastic bag close to his chest, tight.
A bartender hands Raj a mint green drink and Leonard a beer bottle, at the bar.
Raj and Leonard clink their drinks together at the bar, with a plate of shrimp between them.
A woman in a black dress approaches Raj at the bar and places her wine glass down right next to him.
A woman in a black dress waves her purse with a wine glass in her other hand, while leaning at the bar.
Raj bows in a bar at the woman in a black dress, then she walks away, holding her wine glass.
A woman in a black dress, seated at a bar, moves her finger around her wine glass, then turns around.
Penny turns away from Sheldon while they sit on the sofa and rubs her fingers against her right temple, then turns back toward him, surprised.
Penny standing leans forward and looks at Sheldon, who is sitting on the couch, with her hands on her knees.
Raj raises both hands and gives a thumbs-up sign while standing at the bar between a woman in a black dress and Leonard.
Howard, upright, shakes hands with the woman in a black dress at the bar, when Raj and Leonard look at each other with a smile.
Penny, in a pink robe, places a pillow and blanket on the sofa next to Sheldon, who is reading a magazine.
Penny, in a pink robe, stands with her arms crossed, looking irritated, while Sheldon lies stretched out on the couch beside her.
A woman in a black dress, sitting at the table in a bar with Howard, leans forward to him and touches his cheek with a finger.
Penny, in a pink robe, sits down on the bed next to Sheldon, who is lying down.
Leonard with a black suitcase in his hand, comes up the stairs and unlocks the apartment door.
